name: uml_focus_bundle
description: Build a deeper UML bundle around a directory, module, or symbol including neighborhood expansion.

inputs.neighbor_depth: How far incoming/outgoing dependencies should be expanded. Defaults to 2.
inputs.output_dir: Optional output directory. Defaults to Docs/uml/focus/<scope>.

outputs.bundle_summary: JSON summary of the focused UML bundle.
outputs.diagrams: Generated PlantUML and Mermaid files for the focused scope.
